descriptionByLocale.it:
Do you enjoy problem solving and collaboration? Do you have proven experience in working with clients within financial services? Are you detail oriented, even when multitasking? Do you know how to shine in a supporting role? We’re looking for a Collateral Specialist to:
• Support the Wealth Management Retail Margin client base ensuring trade activities and disbursements are managed properly and accurately to prevent potential exposure
• Support UBS Bank USA with providing clients with Non-Purpose and Purpose loans
• Collaborate with the business and credit risk to mitigate any potential financial and regulatory risk
• Meet operational, reporting and standards needs as part of providing services to facilitate risk mitigation or meet regulatory requirements Multi task between email communications and working the ServiceWorks exception tool which provides margin exceptions to be reviewed and responded to
